alt: 大家趁剛開始時精神充足，一口氣把整面佈告欄布置完成，沒有做到一半就分心停下。
scene_prompt: 一鼓作氣 means using the initial burst of energy to finish a task in one sustained effort. Modern classroom decorating project. Three enthusiastic older children work with strong shared momentum along ONE long bulletin board: first area at LEFT already neatly covered with ORIGINAL cut-paper flowers, center being completed by one child, final small corner at RIGHT receiving the LAST flower from another child, while third brings the last supplies. Their focused cheerful body language and nearly finished continuous board show they are carrying their fresh motivation all the way to completion, not resting or abandoning the work. A small plain drum on a shelf can subtly echo the idiom without becoming a music lesson. No readable banners, letters, numbers, brand characters, sharp tools or fireworks.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist. Scene:
